title: comfy build validate --json data payload
description: Offline authoring and wire validation of the local spec, with optional advisory public-model lookup states.

warnings.description: Gaps in the definition that do not stop this command but stop a later one, as `{code, message}`: `build_comfy_version_missing` (no `baseComfyVersion`, which `release create` refuses). Empty when there are none.

model_lookups.description: Present always; filled only with `--remote`. One entry per model, in the order of `wire_definition.models`: the spec as read, which sorts models by `type`, `filename` and `sha256`, so neither that order nor the index in `entry` (`definition.models[<n>]`) is the order of the entries in the spec file. `state` is `candidate_found`, `none_found`, `lookup_error` or `not_lookupable` from the filename lookup, or, for a model whose own https `sourceUri` states a sha256 (a link that is not https is never asked) (Hugging Face's `X-Linked-Etag`), `declared_ok` when it equals the model's `sha256` and `declared_mismatch` when it does not, with the link's hash in `sourceSha256`. A link that states no hash, does not answer, or comes after the 15-second budget for all link checks is spent gets the filename lookup, except for a model with no `filename`, which reads `not_lookupable` with no lookup.

folder_case_checked.description: Present only when the spec has models. False when no usable folder list was read from the builder (offline, without `--remote`; a read that failed or named no folder), so a case variant of a folder (`Loras` for `loras`) passed unchecked; the builder refuses it at the release.
